mapper.select: SELECT w.user_id AS userId, u.real_name AS memberName, SUM(w.hours) AS totalHours, COUNT(DISTINCT w.task_id) AS taskCount FROM t_worklog w LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON w.user_id = u.id WHERE w.status = 1 AND w.project_id = #{projectId} AND w.work_date >= #{startDate} AND w.work_date <= #{endDate} GROUP BY w.user_id, u.real_name ORDER BY totalHours DESC
